title: Sagrada Família tour was Amazing!
text: Amazing tour and review of Sagrada Familia!  Sara was our tour guide and she was outstanding.  Friendly, informative and flexible.  Tour was well worth the time and price!
author: janetsS623TR

title: Enjoyed the private tour
text: Our guide, Clara, was wonderful and very knowledgable.   The private tour was very nice in the Sagrada Familia, but the Casa Battlo is very crowded and the private tour was not as enjoyable because it is hard to move around.   Clara did her best.
author: Wesley_G

title: Amazing
text: We learned so much about Gaudi and his work from our incredible tour guide, Jenna!  She was so knowledgeable and enthusiastic and kept us moving, but at the same time allowed us time to do the things we wanted to do.
author: Susan_B

title: My husband and I are very happy we...
text: My husband and I are very happy we booked this private tour. Our guide, Anna, was exceptional -- very friendly, personable, and knowledgeable. She took the time to get to know us when we first met - the three of us chatted for a few minutes on interests, etc. Anna was then able to even further customize our tour. We have to admit that we really didn't know much about Gaudi, but after our tour - wow! Yes, we would have been impressed by what we saw without the tour, but with Anna's detailed knowledge and explanations, our explorations were wonderful. We better understood Gaudi, his vis
author: Lynne_K

title: We chose this as private tour with...
text:
We chose this as private tour with just 4 of us and our delightful and highly knowledgeable professional guide, Clara This tour included Casa Battlo which was our first stop.
Clara was absolutely immersed in her knowledge of all things relating to Antonio Gaudi and his work throughout Barcelona. With her information through Casa Battlo we got a true feeling of his work on this renovation and his basic design concepts that would lead him to developing the Sagrada Familia.She was able to point out so many small details of his work inside this home and made this part of the tour wonderfu
author: Ralph_D

title: Sagrada Familia Private Tour with Skip The Line
text: Wonderful, well informed guide. Great tour. Seems a little expensive as no taxi/vehicle transfers included. Meeting spot was too vague which made it difficult to meet up. The Cathedral is definitely a "not to miss" whilst in Barcelona.
author: bronwyn2000

title: Cynthia was very knowledgeable on...
text: Cynthia was very knowledgeable on everything Gaudi. Cynthia was all over the place and at times it was difficult to take pictures without having her arms and hands in the picture. La Sagrada Familia was stunning and the history was very interesting. Casa Mila apartment building was only viewed from the outside. Casa Batllo was beautiful and interesting inside and out, but a little claustrophobic in places. The cost per person was a little high considering the tour was primarily of the cathedral.
author: Sharon L

title: Barcelona holiday
text: The Sagrada Familia was a excellent tour the guide was very informative about the church and how Gaudi designed it
